description: Single declaration of the Agent knowledge sources and the surfaces they project to. scripts/generate-mcp-resources.mjs validates this manifest and generates the MCP Resources payload from the exact sources named here. Sources: 'repo' paths are repository files; 'kit' paths are files inside the published Agent operating kit (GET /api/agent/kit), which is itself generated from repository sources.

resources.name: Live-session quickstart
resources.description: Bootstrap, empty-document creation, and edit loop for one browser-authorized session.

resources.name: Session contract
resources.description: The four operations, idempotency, scopes, and limits of one session.

resources.name: Built-in authoring contract
resources.description: Authority split between the catalog, the snapshot, and capabilities; product primitives.

resources.name: Schematic workflow
resources.description: Required read, edit, refresh, render, and review loop with stop-instead-of-guess rules.

resources.name: Tool behavior
resources.description: Runtime behavior of typed transactions, route geometry, movement, and rendering.

resources.name: Response semantics and recovery
resources.description: Interpreting results by layer, failures, conflicts, and completion decisions.

resources.name: Route tree shapes
resources.description: Canonical route-tree topologies the routing expander produces.

resources.name: Routing and diagnostics
resources.description: Reading routing facts and visual diagnostics before editing.

resources.name: Circuit style knowledge
resources.description: Razavi-style placement, labeling, and drawing conventions.

resources.name: Reviewed built-in Razavi catalog
resources.description: Reviewed built-in symbol IDs, canonical pin order, default variants, and the VDD authoring primitive.

resources.name: Advanced transaction contract
resources.description: Full typed edit union schema. Reading this resource unlocks the advanced_transact escape hatch in the same MCP session.
